description: The file is an HTML source code for a web-based database viewer interface. It includes styles and scripts for displaying databases, tables, and data, and handles fetching data via API endpoints.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a specific database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a specific table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data in an HTML table within the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling long text and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for full display.
